## Requirements (contract)

- `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` ×4 (3 CCOPS → `government_mandated_disclosure`;
  FEMA → `procurement`), reviewed `live_targets` rows, committed fixtures,
  shadow diff 0 per source.
- CCOPS: jurisdiction index page → bounded document fan-out
  (`max_documents` per adapter); `Date:`/anchor/filename reporting-period
  extraction; multi-technology field/anchor extraction; adapter-level
  legal-authority patterns; mandated field-state claims preserved.
- FEMA: USAspending `spending_by_award` assistance slice (97.067 HSGP),
  `award_kind="prime"` + `award_class="assistance"`; `funder`/`recipient`
  entity-ref claims + candidate identifiers; §11.12 `FundingInstrument` only
  when funder AND recipient are evidenced; funding ≠ deployed, always.

  successes registered `ingestion_permitted=false` only; persistent
  failures recorded honestly.
- Hosted: SHA-tagged image, 4 new jobs + schedulers by pinned digest,
  land + `ingest_run_completion`, rights `--apply`, resolution +
  accountability materialize, +0 re-runs; honest measurements.
- Build-memory closeout + stacked PR.

## Plan (landed)

- **`government_mandated_disclosure.py`**: `_reporting_period` extended
  (`Date:` labels, anchor-derived years, filename/report-title years);
  technology extraction supports field patterns, anchor patterns, and
  multi-capture fields; adapter-level `legal_authority_pattern`;
  jurisdiction index pages resolve into bounded document targets
  (`max_documents` per adapter).
- **Vocab** `government_mandated_disclosure_vocab.toml`: version bump +
  `[sources]`/`[adapters]` for oakland/cambridge/somerville (index URL,
  link filters, anchors, bounds, agency + enacting-body semantics).
- **`procurement.py`**: `fema_hsgp_allocations` joins the USAspending
  family; `award_class = "assistance"` selects the federal-assistance
  normalization — `Awarding Sub Agency` preferred as `funder`, `Recipient
  Name` as `recipient`, `federal_grant` FundingInstrument (award id +
  funder + recipient all required); candidate identifiers only, never
  silent resolution; no deployment predicates.
- **`runner.py`**: four `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entries + fixture-run
  target selection for `fema_hsgp_allocations` (uses the reviewed
  `live_targets` rows so `award_class` provenance is preserved — the same
  carve-out `oversight_report` already needed).
- **`live_targets.toml`**: reviewed rows — Oakland PAC index
  (`max_documents=8`, `.pdf` under `/documents/pac/`); Cambridge LegiFile
  index (`FileOpen.aspx`, `max_documents=2`); Somerville Legistar index
  (`View.ashx`, `max_documents=6`); FEMA two-page bounded
  `usaspending_award_search` slices (97.067, FEMA subtier, assistance
  type codes 02–05, limit 100/page).
- **`catalog_sweep.py`**: `retry` subcommand — re-probes the 68 `error`
  rows once, writes a dated outcome artifact.
- **Fixtures** `tests/connectors/fixtures/ccops/` (3 index excerpts +
  `SOURCES.md`) + `tests/connectors/fixtures/fema_hsgp_page1.json`
  (incl. one missing `Recipient Name` row proving FundingInstrument
  suppression).
- **`ops/cadence.toml`**: monthly `[[sources]]` rows days 18–21 @ 06:09
  UTC; stale `live_dispositions` rows removed.
- **Hosted**: same recipe as P31.12 — `git archive` → Cloud Build →
  `sig-api:ingest-<sha>` pinned by digest; only the four new jobs.
